questions: Should the 'Mean' column be the average of the component values across columns for each row (row-wise mean) or across rows for each component (column-wise mean)?
If n_components is greater than the number of features in the data matrix, should PCA raise an error, set n_components to min(n_samples, n_features), or use a different default?
Should the cumulative explained variance plot include a point for zero components (i.e., start at 0) or only for 1 to n_components?
Should the x-axis of the plot be integer indices (1,2,...) or continuous range? Should markers be added?
If the data matrix has fewer rows than n_components, should PCA be applied? Should n_components be limited?
Should the PCA be fitted on the data matrix as-is, or should the data be centered/scaled beforehand?
Should the function handle non-numeric data or missing values in the input matrix?
Should the plot be displayed (plt.show()) or just the Axes object returned?
